_schema.id: kebab-case unique id (node id becomes rule:<id>)
_schema.title: short human title
_schema.statement: the rule itself, one imperative sentence
_schema.context: list of trigger keywords/phrases — when should this rule surface?
_schema.source: note path(s) proving the rule (join several with '+') -> 'proves' edges
_schema.links: list of rule:/procedure:/note ids -> 'applies' or 'concerns' edges

rules.title: Always review before sending
rules.statement: Always re-read any outbound message or document once before sending it.

rules.title: Backup before any migration
rules.statement: Never run a data migration without a verified backup taken first.

rules.title: One change at a time
rules.statement: When debugging, change exactly one variable between two attempts.
